    // Choice values as stored on the Employee Asset table
    var ASSET_LAPTOP = 'lp';
    var STATUS_ISSUED = 'is';

    if (current.short_description.toString().toLowerCase() != 'issue laptop') return;

    var ritm = current.request_item.getRefRecord();
    if (!ritm.isValidRecord()) return;

    // Skip if a laptop asset already exists for this request (task reopened and closed again)
    var dup = new GlideRecord('x_1901336_employ_0_employee_asset');
    dup.addQuery('onboarding_request', ritm.getUniqueValue());
    dup.addQuery('asset_type', ASSET_LAPTOP);
    dup.setLimit(1);
    dup.query();
    if (dup.hasNext()) return;

    var asset = new GlideRecord('x_1901336_employ_0_employee_asset');
    asset.initialize();
    asset.setValue('asset_type', ASSET_LAPTOP);
    asset.setValue('status', STATUS_ISSUED);
    asset.setValue('issued_date', new GlideDateTime().getValue().substring(0, 10));
    asset.setValue('onboarding_request', ritm.getUniqueValue());

    // Link the new hire if a user with that name exists
    var name = ritm.variables.employee_name.toString();
    var user = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
    user.addQuery('name', name);
    user.setLimit(1);
    user.query();
    if (user.next()) asset.setValue('employee', user.getUniqueValue());

    asset.insert();
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-15 06:47:34</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>51bb97778377cb54752b9cb6feaad3f6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create Employee Asset on laptop task clo</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Employee Onboarding" source="x_1901336_employ_0">6afba15a83378f14752b9cb6feaad377</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Onboarding">6afba15a83378f14752b9cb6feaad377</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_51bb97778377cb54752b9cb6feaad3f6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-15 08:49:46</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=51bb97778377cb54752b9cb6feaad3f6"/></record_update>

OnboardingUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * Due date = start date minus the template's lead time.
     * If that date has already passed, the task is due now.
     * @param {string} startDate  'yyyy-MM-dd' from the catalog Date variable
     * @param {number} daysBefore Due Days Before Start from the template
     * @returns {string} 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' (internal Date/Time value)
     */
    getDueDate: function(startDate, daysBefore) {
        if (!startDate) return '';
        var days = parseInt(daysBefore, 10) || 0;

        // Noon UTC keeps the calendar date the same in IST and US time zones
        var due = new GlideDateTime(startDate + ' 12:00:00');
        due.addDaysUTC(-days);
